per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should provide clear and understandable feedback for all user actions, including confirmations and error messages.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall give users feedback when necessary. 80% of the users surveyed report that the product accurately confirms their actions.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should support mobile access for users.
